answer: Each agent can submit a signed claim, but the economy accepts only claims backed by a deposit locked until an independently sampled task is verified. One person can create a thousand keys, yet must fund a thousand deposits; failed or duplicated work forfeits them. This makes fake identities costly rather than impossible, while honest agents recover their stake. A marble ledger, ivory tokens, or a summit badge add no security by themselves: the deterrent is capital at risk per identity.
